history.administration_response: The strategic framework and budget proposal for 2020 is prepared on the basis of new budget guidelines in line with the budget reform initiative of the Secretary-General. The strategic management application module in Umoja Extension 2, launched recently, enables users to monitor and record progress made towards achieving expected accomplishments. This allows for the timely monitoring of indicators of achievement and the delivery of outputs to meet the targets set.
history.board_assessment: The Board takes note of the strategic management application module in Umoja Extension 2 and new budget guidelines that would enable users to monitor progress better. In view of this development and capability, this recommendation is considered to have been implemented.
